You grade answers about Indian health-insurance rules (IRDAI).

Question: When was the product withdrawn?

Reference answer: The withdrawal date of the product is listed under the field "Date of withdrawal of the product."
Key facts from the source rule: Date of withdrawal of the product

Answer to grade: According to [chunk 37] of the IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024), a withdrawn Individual Health Insurance product/add-on/rider shall not be offered to new customers after the date of the withdrawal. Existing customers of a withdrawn product shall be provided the following options: a. A one-time option to renew the existing product, if renewal falls within the 90 days from the date of withdrawal of the product; or b. Migrate to any other suitable product (any other existing product or modified version of the withdrawn product) as per the choice of the policyholder.

Grade the answer against the reference and key facts only:
- "correct": states the rule correctly; it may be shorter or worded differently, extra detail is fine if not wrong
- "partial": right in part, but misses a key condition, number or date, or is vague
- "wrong": contradicts the reference, gives a different rule or number, or does not answer
Ignore citation markers like [chunk 12].
Reply with JSON only: {"verdict": "correct" | "partial" | "wrong", "reason": "<at most 12 words>"}

content: {"verdict": "wrong", "reason": "Does not state the specific withdrawal date."}
